description: An original license-plate-frame concept sized for a Genesis GV60. This is a placeholder brief only - no CAD/assets have been generated yet. Must be an original frame design, not a reproduction of any manufacturer logo, badge, or trademarked design.
constraints: Original design only - do not reproduce the Genesis/Hyundai logo, badges, or any trademarked marks (see docs/licensing-policy.md).

Exterior automotive use: material choice needs UV/weather resistance and impact tolerance in mind (see config/materials.json - ASA is a reasonable candidate over PLA); confirm material choice with a human before finalizing.
Exact plate frame dimensions and mounting hole positions must be measured/confirmed against the real vehicle before CAD work begins - do not guess mounting dimensions.

This part is exterior and load-bearing at the mounting points; validation and human slicer review are required, and print-ready status additionally requires human confirmation of fit on the actual vehicle.
